Rewrite the post-2007 branch to report a violation only when constructionDate >= 2007-07-01, summerLoadLineFreshWaterDraught > upperIceWaterlineDraught, and the complete evidence condition is NOT satisfied. Rewrite the pre-2007 branch similarly for constructionDate < 2007-07-01 and upperIceWaterlineDraught < summerLoadLineFreshWaterDraught: complete marking evidence must pass without requiring firstScheduledDryDockingDate; otherwise the dry-docking date must exist, and when it is <= assessmentDate the complete markings must exist. Preserve the supplied assessmentDate and existing certificate/document, owner, datatype, and unit constraints.
